transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Venue Operations Director. I know we've got the filmmaker Q&A planned for the outdoor courtyard after the evening screening, with four speakers and a podcast recording. Before I can sign off on the final production and release plan and open the courtyard to guests, I need to hear status reports from both the sound lead and the rights lead, as per our standard production meeting process. Could we get started with those updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Hi Mara, I'm Jonah, the Live Sound Engineer. I can give my sound status report now. I completed an RF survey of the courtyard after soundcheck, and I found that wireless microphones are unreliable there due to interference from the neighboring broadcast compound. The Q&A will need to use exactly four wired microphones instead. One note: the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder, so it's not in there yet. I'll get it uploaded as soon as possible.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Hi Mara, I'm Elena, the Rights and Clearances Manager. Here's my rights status report: I confirmed with the filmmaker's representative that the appearance release permits an audio-only recording, prohibits public video release, and allows the podcast episode to be released only on September 15, 2026. This confirmation arrived after the rights packet was circulated and has not yet been entered in the event file, so I'm flagging it now.
transcript.speaker: A3
